rules.title: Ban on algorithmic and AI-driven rent pricing software
rules.citation: Policy order passed by Cambridge City Council on June 21, 2026
rules.quote: City council also unanimously passed a policy order initiating steps to ban residential property management companies from contracting companies that use algorithmic and AI-driven models to recommend what they should charge for rent.
rules.summary: The city council passed a policy order to ban property management companies from using algorithmic and AI-driven software to set rents.
rules.coverage_text: Applies to residential property management companies in Cambridge
